WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT AlbumId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(ar.rate - om.mean_rate) AS average_excess
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE ar.rate > om.mean_rate
